_comment: The ndX ranking panel ('Find informative projections'), drawn by emtk's view_form over ndxplorer.ui.projection_rank.ProjectionRankModel. The table is a data_table section; its columns come from the model because the score's name and range depend on the method.

sections.label: Score
sections.description: What makes a view informative. Class separation: bursts of one class sit together (needs classes). Population structure: the cloud splits into more than one population. Correlation: the two parameters co-vary.

sections.label: Classes
sections.description: The classes a view should separate: the gate in the Selection table, each gate as its own population, the clusters, or the z parameter. Parameters a gate is defined on are left out.

sections.label: Sample
sections.description: Bursts drawn at random for scoring. The same sample serves every view, so views are compared on identical bursts.

buttons.label: Start
buttons.description: Start the ranking, continue it, or restart it with new settings.

buttons.label: Pause
buttons.description: Stop scoring; Start continues from here.

sections.title: Ranked views - click one to show it
